profiles.name: Gregory Poferl
profiles.notes: New independent bridge: 2004 APWU bulletin identifies St Paul union activist and Army veteran Greg Poferl entering Waseca for 90-day SOA sentence. October 2021 Union Advocate review by Bill Moore describes federal civil-disobedience imprisonment, APWU leadership, 2004 retirement, subsequent San Miguel and Cretin-Derham Hall teaching, wife Mary Beth and memoir Turning Points. University of Minnesota independently confirms Cretin-Derham Hall social studies teacher. This resolves prior teacher-versus-activist uncertainty and supports further verification of ORF named right-hand subject. Downloaded newsletter is six PDF sheets; article on PDF sheet 5 (printed page 8), not index 11 despite search header. Extracted images but no accepted individual portrait; one visually inspected extraction was unrelated shooting instruction. Awards article HTML contains only site icons; no portrait. Next step inspect ORF original and caption, crop and deploy if quality adequate.
profiles.rights: ORF credit with article; no open license established. No crop or deployment this run.
